name: Pallu
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites. The ending ites means the descendants of, the people you belong to: Israelites are the descendants of Israel, Edomites the descendants of Edom, and so it goes all down the line through the scriptures.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel
